source: Default account numbers of the Vietnamese enterprise accounting regime for the basic ledger purposes, used when exporting the general journal to accounting software. Based on Circular 99/2025/TT-BTC (replacing Circular 200/2014, in force from 2026-01-01) and Circular 133/2016/TT-BTC for small and medium enterprises. Needs checking against the original circulars and by an accountant before use; a tenant can set its own code on each account (external_code).
